Convert an LFQData object to a SummarizedExperiment

Source: R/LFQData.R
lfqdata_to_summarized_experiment.Rd

Builds a SummarizedExperiment with the response as the assay LFQ (and the child counts as nr_children when present; features in rows, samples in columns), the hierarchy keys as row data and the sample annotation as column data, for use with Bioconductor packages.

Usage

lfqdata_to_summarized_experiment(lfqdata)

Arguments

lfqdata

LFQData object with the data and its configuration

Value

SummarizedExperiment (bioconductor)

Details

For compatibility with Bioconductor

See also

Other LFQData: AggregateLimpa, AggregateMedpolish, AggregateRlm, AggregateTopN, AggregatorBase, LFQData, LFQDataPlotter, LFQDataStats, LFQDataSummariser, lfqdata_from_wide(), plot.LFQData()

Examples


istar <- prolfqua::sim_lfq_data_peptide_config()
#> `protein_Id`: columns `proteinID`, `idtype2` united with separator '~'.
#> creating sampleName from file_name column
#> setup_analysis: dropped 6 unconfigured columns: average_prot_abundance, sd, mean, N, avg_peptide_abd, Replicate.
#> setup_analysis: added 36 rows with NA response for feature and sample combinations absent from the input.
data <- istar$data
lfqdata <- LFQData$new(data, istar$config)
lfqdata$data_wide()
